nativeBoundary.producer: CreateBuilder creates real ApplicationBuilder. UseWhen immediately configures real child builders; Build appends main to branch, builds delegates and reverse-composes middleware. Native tests invoke the resulting RequestDelegate with their actual DefaultHttpContext.
nativeBoundary.observable: Exact parent/child/grandchild counts after genuine rejoin, terminating grandchild and false predicate; argument-null exceptions for predicate/configuration.

items.declared: HttpContext.Items is replaceable IDictionary<object, object?>; helper keys are non-nullable string and native keys are the literals parent, child, grandchild.
items.actualDefaultProducer: DefaultHttpContext lazily fetches IItemsFeature using new ItemsFeature(); ItemsFeature constructs ItemsDictionary; ItemsDictionary lazily creates Dictionary<object, object?> on first write.
items.comparer: Default Dictionary<object, object?> uses EqualityComparer<object>.Default, observed as ObjectEqualityComparer<object>. String keys use case-sensitive value equality, not reference equality. This is not a universal comparer promise for caller-supplied Items replacements.
items.missing: ItemsDictionary indexer returns null for missing keys, not KeyNotFoundException. ContainsKey returns false without creating backing storage when storage is uninitialized.
items.otherProducer: ApplicationBuilder's actual default terminal writes __RequestUnhandled=true and sets 404 when response has not started. It is not executed when Increment's terminate flag short-circuits. Supplemental checks observe this real terminal instead of injecting a next callback.
items.increment: Increment factory captures key and terminate at pipeline configuration, returning middleware. Middleware runs only when its real branch is selected: absent=>boxed Int32 1; present boxed Int32 n=>1+n; present null or any non-Int32=>boxed Int32 1. Native defaults are unchecked, so MaxValue wraps to MinValue. It then returns Task.FromResult<object?>(null) if terminating, otherwise calls the Use-produced simpleNext function.
items.count: Count is a post-execution private test reader, not production middleware: absent=>0; present boxed Int32=>that exact value; present null/non-Int32=>0; no writes.
items.nullKeyBoundary: Helpers annotate string non-null. Diagnostic invalid-null Count on fresh uninitialized Items returns 0; first invalid-null pipeline write creates backing Dictionary then throws ArgumentNullException(paramName key); subsequent invalid-null Count throws the same exception type/parameter. These are private-helper/invalid-input characterizations, not valid HTTP-producer reachability.
items.excluded: No replacement/custom Items dictionaries, concurrent mutation, null HttpContext, browser/server transport, or external traffic was executed.
